title: A Cold Morning
text:
It is cold today. Anna wears a warm coat, a hat and red gloves. The sky is grey and it is raining a little.

At school, her friend Ali says his new jacket is very warm. Anna likes his blue jacket, but she thinks her coat is better for the rain. Next week, the weather will be sunny, so they will wear light clothes.

options: a warm coat, a hat and red gloves

questions.text: Why does Anna think her coat is better?
options: It is more expensive than Ali's jacket.
It is good for the rain.
It is the newest in the class.
It is lighter than Ali's jacket.

questions.text: What will the children probably wear next week?

vocabulary.definition: a warm piece of clothing that you wear over other clothes
clothes you wear on your hands to keep them warm

paragraph_translations: Bugün hava soğuk. Anna sıcak bir mont, bir şapka ve kırmızı eldiven giyiyor. Gökyüzü gri ve biraz yağmur yağıyor.

Okulda, arkadaşı Ali yeni ceketinin çok sıcak olduğunu söylüyor. Anna onun mavi ceketini beğeniyor, ama yağmur için kendi montunun daha iyi olduğunu düşünüyor. Gelecek hafta hava güneşli olacak, bu yüzden hafif kıyafetler giyecekler.
